description: Search and read Notion pages, blocks and databases, and create or update pages, blocks, database rows and schemas in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Notion session.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for pages and blocks in the Notion workspace by text query

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List all pages in the Notion workspace, sorted by last edited time. Use this to get an overview of workspace content.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get a Notion page by ID, including its title, metadata, and content blocks. Returns the page info and its direct child blocks.

tools.name: get_block_children
tools.description: Get the child blocks of a specific block or page. Useful for reading nested content.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new page in the Notion workspace. The page is created at the top level of the workspace by default, or as a child of an existing page.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update a page title, icon, or cover image in Notion

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Archive (soft-delete) a page in Notion. The page can be restored from trash.

tools.name: append_block
tools.description: Append a content block (text, heading, list item, quote, code, etc.) to a page or block. Use this to add content to existing pages.

tools.name: update_block
tools.description: Update the text content of a block in a Notion page. Replaces the block text with the new content.

tools.name: delete_block
tools.description: Delete a content block from a Notion page. The block and its children are removed.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get profile information for the current authenticated Notion user or a specific user by ID

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List all users (members) in the current Notion workspace

tools.name: get_database
tools.description: Get a Notion database (collection) schema including its properties/columns and their types. Use this to understand the structure before querying.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Query rows from a Notion database with optional search. Returns items with their property values.

tools.name: create_database_item
tools.description: Add a new row/item to a Notion database. Use get_database first to understand the property schema.

tools.name: update_database_item
tools.description: Update a row/item in a Notion database. Use get_database first to understand the property schema.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List all databases in the Notion workspace. Returns databases sorted by last edited time.

tools.name: create_database
tools.description: Create a new database in a Notion page. Creates a basic database with a title column.
